build_votenet_model: build a VoteNet model for 3D object detection in point clouds with hough voting
run_votenet_forward: run a forward pass of VoteNet on point cloud inputs to generate proposals
create_votenet_with_backbone: create a VoteNet model with pointnet2 or sparseconv backbone for feature learning
test_votenet_inference: test VoteNet inference on a sample point cloud and print end points
compute_votenet_loss: compute the detection loss for VoteNet predictions using ground truth labels
